comments.author: Beomi
comments.body:
Legacy Theme 5: "Rhodes the Port City" Legacy TH5. After the Giant Statue
Direction: Center (0:00)

It is known that you can gain those items below (at light pillar)

Rhodes' Armour
Rhodes' Sandals
Rhodes' Earrings
Spare Sail Arrangement Set
Ancient Iron Meteorite

It is also known that Spade(White/Black) can be obtained here!

Trade Goods
Bronze

I'm not sure which rank is required to obtain all those items. But someone reported Search 14R is enough to obtain Shoes/Armour/Sandals.
